tasks.title: Website Performance & Broken Link Audit
tasks.description: Perform a desktop browser check on 5 landing page URLs, check for layout issues, and report any 404 links found.
tasks.instructions:
1. Open the audit target URL in Chrome or Safari.
2. Click each footer navigation item.
3. Note down any non-functional links or slow loading assets.
4. Summarize your findings in the proof submission box.
tasks.proofInstructions: Detail at least 3 inspected subpages with load speed observation and list any broken links or confirm none found.

tasks.title: Video Testing: Watch 3-Min Demo Video & Answer 3 Checkpoints
tasks.description: Watch an upcoming SaaS product introduction video and answer 3 short verification questions to confirm clarity.
tasks.instructions:
1. Watch the video at: https://stream.example.com/demo-v2
2. Note the product price mentioned at minute 1:45.
3. Note the primary integration highlighted at minute 2:30.
4. Submit your concise answers.
tasks.proofInstructions: Answer: 1) Price mentioned, 2) Primary integration name, 3) One key benefit.
